description: This file defines classes, structures, and caches related to Vulkan pipeline state objects, render pass descriptions, and layout caching for ANGLE's Vulkan renderer. It includes packed description structures for efficient caching and comparison, as well as cache management classes for render passes, pipelines, descriptor set layouts, and pipeline layouts.

classes.name: rx::vk::RenderPassDesc
classes.description: Represents a packed description of a Vulkan render pass, including color and depth/stencil attachments, with methods for packing formats, hashing, and comparison.

classes.name: rx::vk::AttachmentOpsArray
classes.description: Holds an array of attachment load/store operations with methods for initialization, hashing, and comparison.

classes.name: rx::vk::GraphicsPipelineDesc
classes.description: Encapsulates the description of a graphics pipeline state, including vertex input, render pass, blend, depth/stencil, and other states, with methods for updating and hashing.

classes.name: rx::vk::DescriptorSetLayoutDesc
classes.description: Represents a packed descriptor set layout description, including binding info, with methods for updating, hashing, and comparison.

classes.name: rx::vk::PipelineLayoutDesc
classes.description: Describes a pipeline layout, including descriptor set layouts and push constant ranges, with methods for updating and hashing.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for comparing two instances of the respective description classes.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Computes a hash value for the description object for use in caching.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Methods for updating various pipeline states and descriptions.

methods.name: getRenderPassDesc
methods.description: Returns the current render pass description.

methods.name: setRenderPassDesc
methods.description: Sets a new render pass description.
